description: Expert-reviewed corrections of assessed phase-assemblage field names (Dataset 6). Each entry replaces the machine name of one field with the domain expert's decision; the machine name is kept in the record's name_history. PI-approved 2026-10-24. Entries with basis 'page_check' (ORCHID audit round 2, 2026-10-24) are corrections read on the rendered handbook page (image sha256 recorded; no image kept); they are not expert decisions and do not set the expert_reviewed basis.

corrections.source: page check: handbook diagram label (A1 C8 label suspect)
